applyTo: "callback_plugins/**/*.py"
description: "Python guidance for repository-owned Python code."

# Python Guidance

- Keep dependencies limited to the standard library unless approval adds one.
- Preserve callback and plugin public contracts.
- Use clear error handling and avoid swallowing failures.
- Add focused tests when behavior is practical to test.
- Run available syntax or test checks; do not claim unavailable tooling ran.
